title: AGRAA
tagline: Decentraloan revolutionizes lending with blockchain and smart contracts. Borrowers access loans with ease, while lenders enjoy automated repayments. NFT collateral adds security. Trust, transparency, and efficiency in one platform.
description:
Decentraloan is your gateway to a new era of decentralized lending and borrowing. In the world of finance, we're changing the rules of the game by empowering individuals to create, lend, and manage loans securely and efficiently. Our platform leverages blockchain technology to ensure trust, transparency, and reliability, without the need for intermediaries.

Key Features:

P2P Lending: Decentraloan enables users to create loans and others to access these funds directly, fostering a peer-to-peer lending ecosystem. Say goodbye to traditional banks and credit agencies.

Blockchain-Powered Security: All your data is stored in a tamper-proof blockchain and smart contracts. Your transactions are safe, transparent, and verifiable at any time.

Dynamic Smart Contracts: Every deal results in the creation of dynamic smart contracts, ensuring that the terms of the loan are automatically enforced, eliminating the need for complex legal paperwork.

NFT Integration: Users can collateralize their loans with NFTs. When a borrower defaults, the NFT becomes the property of the lender, allowing the lender to recoup their investment.

Benefits for Borrowers:

Access to decentralized loans without the need for a traditional financial institution.
Transparent loan terms and automated repayment schedules.
The option to collateralize loans with NFTs, making borrowing more flexible and secure.
Benefits for Lenders:

Opportunity to earn interest by lending funds directly to borrowers.
Automatic enforcement of loan terms through dynamic smart contracts.
Security through NFT collateral, reducing the risk of default.
Benefits for All:

Eliminate the need for third-party intermediaries, reducing costs and bureaucracy.
A decentralized financial ecosystem built on trust and transparency.
Unlocking new possibilities for financial inclusion and economic empowerment.
how_its_made: We've built a decentralized lending platform using a range of technologies and platforms. We've created smart contracts to manage NFT data (ERC721 tokens) and deployed them on Mantle. We've also stored our data on the Polygon Mumbai testnet to leverage its low cost and speed. For the user interface, we've developed a full-stack web application using React for the frontend, Solidity for the smart contracts, Ethers.js for interacting with Ethereum-based assets, Express for the backend, and integrated Tableland, Polygon, and NFTs into the system. This project required overcoming challenges related to security, user experience, and scalability. The choice of Polygon for scalability and cost-efficiency is especially important given the current state of the Ethereum network.
